notes: First number for the generic (monocular, non-multiview) person path — nothing to be at parity WITH; this is the improvement target. The 3-5x gap to the P3 multiview chain (ground-plane IDF1 0.9456 on the same footage) is the design justification for MVDeTr as a MultiViewDetector component (D9/Phase 3). Known levers not yet applied: v1 stage0 CLAHE preprocessing; tracker operating point for 2 fps annotated rate (or track at the native 60 fps video rate and evaluate on annotated frames); association params were first-shot multiclass adaptations; Market1501 checkpoint has a domain gap to outdoor WILDTRACK (CC-ReID / DINOv2 streams pending). WILDTRACK monocular MOT has no published reference protocol - dense crowd at 2 fps is adversarial for IoU-motion trackers, reflected in the negative MOTAs (FP/FN-heavy) and high fragmentation.
